# DAX Standards Review

Review the active file or selected DAX code.

Use these standards as the only rule sources:

- .github/instructions/dax.instructions.md
- .github/instructions/naming.instructions.md

Return findings grouped into these sections in this order:

1. Formatting Issues
2. Naming Issues
3. Logic and Best Practice Issues

For each finding:

- Quote the problematic code.
- State the violated rule.
- Provide a corrected code version.

If no issues are found, state that no issues were found and list any assumptions made.
